title: Cover permanent immutable-association conflicts during relay page recovery
outcome: A deterministic public-route regression ensures an immutable association conflict at the local remember stage remains a permanent 409 and is never rewritten as temporary home unavailability.
acceptance: A controlled test reaches the local remember stage of first-read recovery with a conflicting immutable association and asserts 409, the original conflict message, no temporary retry advice, and unchanged durable association authority.
The test uses deterministic phase synchronization and passes with the existing relay controls without weakening the recovery fences or increasing timeouts.
